cases.name: seedsigner_dice_99rolls_asked_12w_refusal
cases.reason: 99 rolls cannot produce 12 words on SeedSigner — dice. SeedSigner — dice sets word count from the roll count: 50 rolls -> 12 words, 99 rolls -> 24 words, and it refuses any other pairing. This tool refuses the same inputs the device refuses, on purpose.
